## What it is

This project analyzed a large wellness survey to understand which factors were
most associated with mental and physical health outcomes. The goal was to turn
messy survey data into actionable insight through reproducible analysis and
clear reporting.

## What I did

- Cleaned and structured a 3,000+ response dataset for analysis.
- Performed correlation analysis, demographic segmentation, and regression modeling.
- Built visual summaries including heatmaps to communicate key relationships.

## Outcome

The analysis revealed strong links between declining mental and physical health
for adults ages 56+, and highlighted geographic segments with lower mental
health scores. I translated model and trend outputs into clear findings for
non-technical decision-makers.
